subject: planner: maintain functional dependency in the cascades group (#59475)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on planner cascades memo/property/optimizer changes. The patch adds `FD *funcdep.FDSet` to `property.LogicalProperty`, populates it in `memo.GroupExpression.DeriveLogicalProp()` (using precomputed `BaseLogicalPlan.FDs()` when memo stats-derivation is skipped, otherwise via `LogicalPlan.ExtractFD()`), and triggers `logic.ExtractFD()` early in `core.CascadesOptimize()`; no Blocker/High correctness/semantics/concurrency/compatibility issues found. Checked later history up to `upstream-master`: the same `logic.ExtractFD()` call and group FD derivation remain present (no subsequent fix indicating a latent Blocker/High bug).
